output.brief:
The 22 Oct run was late because of the Q3 margin backfill, not the causes you proposed. It started at 00:58 and held an exclusive lock on stage_orders until 04:18. The nightly merge waited 2h13m for that lock. After that, every step ran at its normal length. Extract volume was normal. customer_ltv added only about 19 minutes. The Corvane incident (02:52–03:37) fell inside the lock wait and didn't slow any step, so it wasn't the cause. I'm fairly sure of this (about 90%). One thing is unknown: whether the implementer meant 13:00 and wrote '1:00', or chose an overnight run on purpose. The change board chair couldn't say, and the implementer is on leave. Please don't treat that as settled.

Recommended: make the nightly job owner a required reviewer for changes to tables it uses. Block writes to those tables from 01:00 to 06:00 unless that owner signs off. Add an alert for lock waits over 15 minutes. Don't move to a higher Corvane tier to fix this. Don't remove customer_ltv, because the retention team uses it for its 08:00 call list. Keep the banner, because it stopped Finance from publishing stale margins. Don't open a disciplinary case: the change board checklist had no step to catch this.
